fixed.explanation: resolveGlobBase replaces every path token, including the host:port, with a placeholder before calling new URL. So URL canonicalization (dropping default ports, encoding spaces, punycode for non-ASCII hosts) never runs on those parts. The fix leaves tokens that contain no glob or escape characters as they are, so new URL normalizes them. Tokens with glob characters are still replaced with placeholders.
